latest_user_hud_override.requirement: User explicitly wants only health and fuel on the riding screen; tapping either opens detailed stats in the phone. Use tire air for bicycles.
latest_user_hud_override.implementation: Two compact 44pt-high icon/percentage buttons. No five-stat panel, balance/level footer or full-width survival warning banner. Full health, energy, hunger, bike condition and resource bars live only in Phone Care. Use tiny attention dots and brief transition warnings instead of permanent extra chrome. This overrides any earlier HUD_HealthMeters blueprint.

personality_one_liner: A vibrant, chunky, and tactile 2D open-city delivery simulator where every action feels like a colorful, interactive comic-book panel.

spacing.rule: Generous padding to make the UI feel chunky and touchable. Important controls (joystick, phone) get oversized tap areas and sit clearly in the thumb zone.

do's: Use on the in-game smartphone UI over the gameplay background
Use for floating HUD elements like the mini-map and stats container
dont's: Do not use on garage cards
Do not use on primary CTA buttons

screens.name: GarageScreen
screens.purpose: The starting hub where the player selects their bike and gear before heading out.

states.loading: Chunky spinning wheel icon in the center.
states.error: Failed to load garage data. Playful error icon with retry button.

screens.layout: Top 50% is a 2D environment (garage_interior image with gradient scrim at bottom). The selected scooter sits in the center of the image. The bottom 50% is a floating bottom-sheet-style card layout (`surfaceSecondary`, `lg` radius) containing horizontal scrolling shelves for Bikes and Gear. Selected items get a `borderStrong` highlight. A sticky 'HEAD OUT' primary CTA (`brandPrimary`, pill shape) anchors the bottom edge inside safe area.

screens.name: GameHUD
screens.purpose: The main playable area overlay containing directional controls, mini-map, in-game phone, survival stats, and ad placeholders.

states.error: Connection lost. Retry button overlaid on frozen game state.

screens.layout: A full-bleed screen for the 2D world. HUD elements sit directly on top. Top-Left: Rounded-square Mini-GPS module with glass background. Top-Right: Stats pill (Earnings) and a read-only Online/Offline indicator beside the weather/time widget. Left/Right margins: Compact survival HUD with visual bars/icons for Health, Energy, Hunger, Bike Condition, Fuel, and Tire Air. Bottom-Left: On-screen directional joystick. Bottom-Right: Interact/Action buttons + 'Open Phone' button. Mid-screen: Integrated placeholders reading 'PLACE FOR ADS' painted on virtual building walls.

screens.name: InGamePhone
screens.purpose: A simulated smartphone interface where the player accepts orders, checks messages, buys food/rain gear, accesses roadside assistance, and toggles online status.

states.empty: No active orders. Friendly illustration inside the phone screen.

screens.layout: Opens as an overlaid centered modal (or right-side panel) when triggered from the HUD. The phone container uses a heavy `borderStrong` outline or distinct `shadow 2` to feel like an object. Inside the phone: a grid of apps (Orders, GPS, Wallet, Food Store, Inventory/Rain Kit, Milestones, and Settings where the Online Toggle & Roadside Assistance sit). When an order arrives, a dynamic notification banner drops from the top of the phone screen with 'Accept' (`brandSecondary`) and 'Decline' (`brandTertiary`) buttons.

screens.name: DeathRecoveryOverlay
screens.purpose: A modal triggered when the player's health hits zero, offering a choice to respawn.
screens.layout: Centered non-dismissible recovery popup. Both choices cancel the active order. Pay 15 coins to recover at the garage while preserving progression, or restart from zero after a second explicit destructive confirmation. Disable paid recovery if balance is insufficient. Use existing comic styling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile/Playful UI rules. Keep elements chunky, rounded (lg to pill), and use high contrast text on the warm background.
Borders (borderStrong) should be utilized sparsely but effectively to make UI elements pop, matching a comic-book aesthetic.
Do NOT redesign the GarageScreen unnecessarily. Keep its current structure.
World expansion: Ensure the game world map is expanded to include 2 towns connected by a forest road. There should be no houses in the forest.
Order mechanics: Orders are location-dependent. Pickups are timed and automatically canceled if missed. Drop-offs and pickups should be strictly on footpaths, not in the middle of roads.
Phone vs HUD: Move the Online/Offline toggle into the phone interface. On the HUD, display a read-only widget showing online/offline status beside the weather/time.
Survival mechanics HUD: Add compact visual indicators (bars/icons) for Health, Energy, Hunger, Bike Condition, Fuel, and Tire Air.
In-Game Phone Apps: Implement a Food Store (buy food/manage hunger), Inventory (buy/equip rain kits), Milestones App (coin/food rewards), and Settings (Roadside assistance, Online Toggle).

Game state events: Apply health drain if hungry/riding in rain without kit. Apply collision damage to bike and energy. Introduce 'slow pushing' mode if fuel/tires are empty, resolved via paying for phone roadside assistance.

Death mechanics: User clarification overrides previous blueprint: cancel the active order in BOTH recovery paths. Pay 15 coins and respawn in garage keeping progression, or explicitly confirm restart from zero if not paying.
Haptics: Ensure heavy impact haptics for collision events, success feedback for completing milestones/orders, and medium haptics for buying items.
